- Application imports domain and exposes `runBillingFlow`.
- Presentation keeps its allowed import of the application use case, then formats the returned result.
- Infrastructure implements any external-package adapter required by `runBillingFlow`.

- `layer_violation` breaks an internal, explicitly configured dependency direction. It makes domain changes pull agents into UI and orchestration code, and here contributes directly to a runtime cycle.
- `deep_import` breaks an external package’s encapsulation boundary. It may work today, but an upgrade can relocate private files without preserving compatibility.
